title: Blanket Unscheduled Jewelry Coverage by Valuables Floater Tier
content:
Besides the items scheduled one by one, the upper tiers of the Larkspur Valuables Floater offer blanket coverage for unscheduled jewelry: a single limit for jewelry that is not listed on the schedule, a most-paid figure for any one unscheduled piece, and a rate for the blanket limit.

| Tier | Blanket unscheduled jewelry limit (USD) | Most paid for one unscheduled item (USD) | Annual premium per 100 USD of blanket limit (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Valuables Floater Classic | 0 | 0 | 0.00 |
| Valuables Floater Select | 0 | 0 | 0.00 |
| Valuables Floater Preferred | 5000 | 1000 | 1.55 |
| Valuables Floater Prestige | 10000 | 2500 | 1.49 |
| Valuables Floater Collector | 25000 | 5000 | 1.42 |
| Valuables Floater Private Client | 50000 | 10000 | 1.35 |

A limit of 0 means the tier has no blanket jewelry coverage, and a per-item figure of 0 means none. The Valuables Floater Classic and Select therefore offer no blanket; the four upper tiers do. The blanket limit a floater carries is recorded on the floater when it is bound.

## Reading the columns

- **Blanket limit**: the amount of unscheduled jewelry covered in blanket on the tier.
- **Most paid for one unscheduled item**: the ceiling for any single unscheduled piece under the blanket, whatever the blanket limit.
- **Blanket rate**: an annual figure per 100 USD of blanket jewelry limit.

## Hypothetical illustration

A hypothetical Valuables Floater Prestige carrying a blanket limit of 10000 USD: that limit is 100 hundreds, and 100 multiplied by the Prestige blanket rate of 1.49 gives 149.00 USD of annual blanket premium. Any one unscheduled ring, bracelet or pendant under that blanket is paid no more than 2500 USD.
